messages:
Maya R: Quick kickoff for token-cost instrumentation. I dropped a first-pass event schema in the tracking doc and we need clear owners for (A) schema review + compatibility rules, (B) ingestion pipeline (kinesis->lake->warehouse), (C) billing join and cost attribution, (D) dashboards/canary metrics. Reply with ownership and any blockers.

Jonah T: I can own schema review + compat rules. Will audit the fields and propose nullable/backcompat rules by EOD tomorrow. Also suggest we include a top-level "schema_rev" and a human-friendly "schema_tag".

Kevin L: Infra takes ingestion. Need exact field names, types, and any high-cardinality fields to avoid in partitioning. Please include which fields are safe to use as partition keys.

Maya R: Good. Sample payload to start (lightweight):

```
{
  "event_type": "token_event",
  "req_id": "req_20260317_001",
  "model_name": "rw-instruct-7b-v2",
  "tokens_total": 312,
  "tokens_input": 112,
  "tokens_output": 200,
  "unit_cost_cents": 4,
  "latency_total_ms": 87,
  "latency_model_ms": 64,
  "kv_cache_hit": false,
  "billing_class": "committed",
  "route_id": "hosted-eu",
  "batch_id": "b-77",
  "ts": "2026-03-17T16:10:05Z",
  "schema_rev": "2026-03-01"
}
```

Selena G: Product note: we need mapping from billing_class -> billing_bucket (free/promo/committed). Priya, do you want to own the join logic in warehouse? Also define retention rules for raw events vs aggregated tables.

Priya S: I can take billing join ownership. Prefer to do join downstream weekly unless we can tag at the edge. Question: will edge-proxy provide billing_class? If not, we need a lightweight customer-lookup table.

Oliver P: Edge-proxy can emit X-RW-Billing-Class header. I have a branch open (https://git.internal/r/redwood/edge-proxy/pulls/427) that sets it from routing decisions. Need a perf microbenchmark before we flip on at scale.

Kevin L: If we can get that header, ingestion can use it as a partition key for staging. Otherwise we default to doing the join in warehouse which is heavier. Also callout: avoid using free-form customer metadata at ingestion.

Jonah T: For latency breakdowns let's standardize field names across services: latency_total_ms, latency_proxy_ms, latency_model_ms, latency_cache_ms. Add these to the schema so dashboards don't need transformation layers.

Maya R: Canary plan proposal: 1-week rolling canary on hosted-eu, 10% traffic, metrics to monitor: tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency, error rate, unit_cost_cents (aggregated), and billing tag correctness. QA to exercise cold/cached paths.

Selena G: I'll author the QA checklist (sample prompts, cache-warm scenarios, billing tag verifications) and attach it to the doc.

Jonah T: Compat rules: schema_rev required, new optional fields are nullable. We should include a "strict_mode" boolean for ingestion to opt-in/out of rejecting unknown fields. Default strict_mode=false for canary, then true for v1.1.

Kevin L: Important blocker: our schema validator in ingestion currently rejects unknown keys. Jonah, please include strict_mode and a migration timeline. Also flag any high-cardinality fields (like request_id) to be excluded from partition keys.

Maya R: Ownership recap: Jonah (schema + compat) by EOD tomorrow, Oliver (edge header perf check) in 48h, Kevin (ingestion stub + validator config) within 4 days, Priya (billing join plan) in next sprint, Selena (QA canary tests) EOW. Objections?

Priya S: No objections. I'll prepare sample join queries and expected outputs for both header-tagged and warehouse-joined workflows.

Oliver P: FYI deploy-bot shows edge-proxy nightly failing unrelated tests, I'm looking into the flaky regression. deploy-bot: https://ci.internal/redwood/edge-proxy/1253

deploy-bot: nightly build failed: 1 flaky e2e. Investigating.

analytics-bot: Ran a smoke check against the staging pipeline: header propagation missing for ~2% of requests. Will re-run after Oliver's fix.

Kevin L: Once analytics-bot confirms header propagation >99%, ingestion team will configure staging pipeline to accept billing_class as partition key and start a small ingest flow.

Maya R: Final ask 1) Jonah, include affected owner list for SDKs/API if we add top-level fields; 2) Everyone, add short comments on the tracking doc so we can triage questions async. This thread will be canonical for blockers/ownership. Thanks :thumbsup:
